name: St Agnes Hotel
accommodation: Six individually designed en-suite rooms, including a family room (king plus two singles)
suitableFor: Couples and families wanting a village pub base
beachAccess: In Churchtown, the centre of St Agnes village; distance to the cove not stated
confirmedFeatures: Smart TV, tea and local coffee, Eve mattresses, breakfast included, bar, restaurant, outdoor terrace
overview: The St Agnes Hotel is a pub with rooms in Churchtown, at the heart of St Agnes village, with the lane down to Trevaunance Cove close by. It has six en-suite rooms, breakfast is included, and the bar and restaurant serve lunch and dinner.
surfTripFit: Staying in the village means shops, food and the road down to Trevaunance are all close. Dogs are welcome, which helps if the dog comes on the trip.
